summary: Highberg B.V.. Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 18% of its 11 jobs here don't ask for Dutch.
sources: IND public register (work / highly skilled migrants), fetched 2026-10-06, https://ind.nl/en/public-register-recognised-sponsors/public-register-regular-labour-and-highly-skilled-migrants
Google News RSS (headline and link only), last 90 days, fetched 2026-10-06

insights.one_liner: Dutch-founded European transformation consultancy and IND recognised sponsor, though most of its jobs here ask for Dutch.

culture.text: Says it works closely with clients as partners in getting things done, combining analytical depth with pragmatism.
Its 11 jobs are mid or senior level in Zoetermeer, Utrecht, Amsterdam and Baarn, mostly consulting and risk and compliance.

open.text: Highberg B.V. is an IND recognised sponsor.
Only 18% of its 11 jobs here work without Dutch; 55% show the pay.

growth.text: Says it was founded in the Netherlands and is growing across Europe.
